=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 138-140 (entire file after codex_config_assemble — model_provider_broker_start, model_provider_broker_stop, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_writer, model_provider_broker_prepare_codex_readonly, model_provider_broker_exec_sanitized, model_provider_broker_exec_unprivileged, model_provider_broker_grant_read_path deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared model-provider broker lifecycle API was deleted while numerous workflow and script callers still invoke it.
  WHY: Brokered phases abort with command-not-found before model execution and lose the documented credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose invocation runs Codex with --sandbox danger-full-access without the model-provider broker.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can access or exfiltrate GH_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY and mutate the workspace.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3040-3052 (_inject_token_into_url), lines 3055-3084 (_resolve_origin_url), lines 2987-2990 (_git_subprocess_env with authentication block removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication now embeds GH_TOKEN directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of using per-command http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: The PAT is exposed in argv, /proc, Git diagnostics, and captured logs.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: line 585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_force_tick_remote_url constructs an authenticated URL with the literal token: printf 'https://x-access-token:%s@%s/%s\n'.
  WHY: Force-tick git commands receive a credential-bearing URL whose token can appear in process listings and diagnostics.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 144, 176-181, 766-768, 882-884, 918-920 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes the authenticated _memory_git wrapper and leaves memory branch operations as bare git commands against an unauthenticated origin.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false, memory branch initialization and writes fail authentication and silently degrade to no-ops.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-158, 241-245 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes sensitive-path filtering from issue- and plan-derived target paths.
  WHY: Paths such as .git/config, .env, .ssh, and .aws can be resolved and inlined into model prompts.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 7-8, 26-30, 52-56, 61 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --process-group-file was removed while scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553 still passes it to the stall guard.
  WHY: The guard exits on an unknown argument before launching isolated editors, matching the repeated empty-editor failures.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 491-497; lines 949-1329 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: git_with_github_auth and the review_blocked_* terminal-action API were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes and review-blocked approval, terminal-action, and successor flows fail or silently skip.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 766-779, 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comment payloads drop id, author_id, author_type, and author_association.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer matching and approver authorization cannot validate comments from the reduced payload.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 105-113, 258-262 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --provider-base-url was removed while callers still pass it and base_url is hardcoded to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
  WHY: Config generation exits on an unknown argument, and bypassing the option would route Codex away from the loopback broker.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-232 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER and STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR, but no workflow step sets or exports them.
  WHY: The protection against branch-owned support-file overwrites is dead code.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh: lines 1-76; scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 226-231 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: staged_support_rebase_conflict output is not mapped into SSB_REASON or SSB_FILES for the staged-support conflict handler.
  WHY: Even if restoration runs, conflicts do not trigger the intended ai:needs-human escalation.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30-37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test imports MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path, both deleted from targeted_file_context.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises ImportError before the targeted-context tests run.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The rewritten emit_context does not count headers, markers, summaries, or path limits toward used_bytes and removes path-count and per-path byte caps.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can exceed TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES and cause repeated Semble queries for paths that cannot be rendered.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-82 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Configure git auth exports GIT_CONFIG_* only within its own step.
  WHY: Later memory-helper steps inherit an unauthenticated origin and cannot perform private-repository memory operations.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 129-131 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When python3 is unavailable, the wrapper executes the child without supervision.
  WHY: An isolated editor can run without heartbeat, stall termination, or process-group cleanup.
- changelog.d/security-pass-cycle-6-immutable-support.md: filename | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment filename omits the required numeric issue-or-PR prefix.
  WHY: It violates the fragment naming contract for release assembly and per-PR uniqueness.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
